name: youtube-watch-party
description: Real-time YouTube Watch Party (React + Express + Socket.IO)

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install --include=dev && cd ../client && npm install --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix client run build
